semiconductor_relevance: High — InnoLas Semiconductor specializes in wafer laser marking and sorting equipment, which is critical for semiconductor and LED manufacturing processes.
summary: InnoLas Semiconductor GmbH is a leading manufacturer of high-quality wafer laser marking and sorting equipment tailored for the semiconductor and LED industries. They provide solutions for wafer sizes ranging from 2" to 450mm, accommodating various materials and offering options such as wafer ID readers and thickness measurement.
capabilities: Wafer laser marking systems for various materials
Wafer sorting equipment for sizes 2" to 450mm
Custom laser adaptations through InnoLas Laser
High throughput and reliability in processing

regional_presence.Germany: InnoLas Semiconductor is based in Germany and serves a worldwide customer base.
